messages:
Renee Park: Quick design jam: should we let people inline-edit the rerank labels in the relevance table? Idea: click the label cell, small textfield pops, save persists to dataset metadata.
Diego Morales: I like inline edits for small corrections. Concern: it may be confusing if edits only live client-side. Must be explicit: "Save changes to dataset" CTA in row or global save.
Hannah Yu: Accessibility: inline fields need proper labels and live announcements. When edit opens, announce "Editing label for row 42" and trap focus. Pressing Enter saves, Esc cancels.
Marco Lin: Implementation note: optimistic UI save then background patch; show inline spinner and undo toast. Backend patch endpoint: PATCH /datasets/:id/rows/:row_id with body {label}.
Renee Park: Copy nudge: placeholder text "Add short label (e.g., 'support', 'faq')" Keep max 30 chars. Also add a tooltip on hover: "Labels help tune reranker exports."
Diego Morales: On keyboard nav: allow arrow keys to move between rows, Enter to open edit, Esc to close without leaving row focus. This keeps power-users efficient.
a11y-bot: Suggest using aria-roledescription="row" and aria-label="row X of Y" for context. When editing, set aria-live="assertive" to announce save results.
Hannah Yu: Export implications: if user edited labels but hasn't saved, the export modal should warn "You have unsaved edits that will not be included unless saved." Offer "Save & Export" primary action.
Marco Lin: Perf edge: when many inline edits occur, batch patches every 2s or on blur. Also throttle autosaves to avoid hot loops.
Renee Park: UX microcopy for warning: "Unsaved edits detected  Save now to include in export." (we'll refine tone).
Diego Morales: Small visual: a pencil icon appears in the header when any inline edit exists, clicking it opens a changelog panel.
Hannah Yu: A11y final: ensure the export dropdown exposes which columns will be included and that label column readout matches what screen readers will get.
a11y-bot: Add acceptance criteria: keyboard edit flow, aria announcements, unsaved-edits modal, batch save behavior.
Renee Park: Thanks everyone. I'll mock a lightweight inline-edit flow and update the export modal to include the "Save & Export" option. Filing DX-4221 and attaching the prototype.
